question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's firm grip on the Chinese Communist Party, Central Military Commission, and key state institutions underpins the 95.5% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Recent personnel shifts and military purges have reinforced rather than eroded his authority, while the absence of a designated successor and lack of visible factional opposition point to continuity at the 21st Party Congress. Elite politics remain opaque but show no evidence of imminent challenges through mid-2026. Even so, low-probability shifts could still occur from an abrupt health event, severe economic pressures triggering elite realignment, or an unforeseen external crisis altering internal dynamics before year-end.
